description: External shell CSR map, roadmap Section 11 register worksheet. One authoritative schema generates register docs, C/Python accessors, SV decode constants and HWH cross-checks. Byte-addressed, 32-bit aligned.

registers.name: ID
registers.desc: IP identifier; low 16 bits magic 0x4D47 ('MG'), high 16 bits revision.

registers.name: ABI
registers.desc: Packet ABI major in [7:0], minor in [15:8].

registers.name: CAPS
registers.desc: Capability bitfield: bit0 streaming input, bit1 DMA input, bit2 model reload, bit3 multi-stream.

registers.name: LIMITS
registers.desc: Compact profile/limit descriptor index into an immutable capability record.

registers.name: COMMAND
registers.desc: Write one full command word. States: idle, loading, ready, busy, fault. Illegal transitions are rejected.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: Current state plus busy/valid flags.

registers.name: ERROR
registers.desc: Sticky cause; retains the first fault until acknowledged via CLEAR_FAULT.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.desc: Write-one-to-clear. IRQ clear removes only consumed sources.

registers.name: DESC_LO
registers.desc: Descriptor address low 32 bits; shadow, captured atomically on command.

registers.name: DESC_HI
registers.desc: Descriptor address high 32 bits; shadow.

registers.name: DESC_LEN
registers.desc: Descriptor length in bytes; shadow.

registers.name: ARG
registers.desc: Command argument word; shadow.

registers.name: MODEL_GEN
registers.desc: Committed model generation; confirmation of commit/configuration.

registers.name: STREAM_EPOCH
registers.desc: Selected stream epoch from the accepted configuration.

registers.name: IRQ_MASK
registers.desc: Interrupt enable mask.

registers.name: SNAP_SEQ
registers.desc: Snapshot sequence; a snapshot command latches counters and advances this.

registers.name: CNT_ACCEPTED
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low word at 0x40, high at 0x44.

registers.name: CNT_COMPLETED
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low then high.

registers.name: CNT_ABORTED
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low then high.

registers.name: CNT_REJECTED
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low then high.

registers.name: CNT_BUSY_CYC
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low then high.

registers.name: CNT_STALL_CYC
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low then high.

registers.name: CNT_DDR_RD
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low then high.

registers.name: CNT_DDR_WR
registers.desc: 64-bit counter, low then high.

rules: Writes to read-only state are ignored and leave read-only state unchanged.
Decouple AXI-Lite write-address and write-data capture so either may arrive first.
A sticky-error clear arriving in the same cycle as a new fault must preserve the new event.
